lines.text: GTA Six isn't even out yet. And it's already made a billion dollars.
That's the estimate from Sensor Tower, for digital pre-orders alone. Take-Two hasn't confirmed it.
The price? Eighty dollars. The Ultimate Edition, a hundred.
lines.say: The price? Eighty dollars. And the ultimate version, a hundred.

lines.text: And Take-Two needs it. Last quarter, bookings fell eighteen percent.
This quarter, they're guiding three point three five to three point five billion. More than double.
Even the CEO is careful. Quote: we tend to avoid claiming success before it occurs.
